'''February 2002 Ayer tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in M's Collectibles, Ayer, Massachusetts on 9 February 2002. [[Stephen Cellucci]] won it. It is known from Stephen Cellucci's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3346">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-10-ayer-ma-2-9-02-taking-care-of-businessd3346/ ayer-ma-2-9-02-taking-care-of-business], DeckTech (Stephen "The Gov'na" Cellucci, 10 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-10-ayer-ma-2-9-02-taking-care-of-businessd3346/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 February 2002
* '''Site:''' M's Collectibles, Ayer, Massachusetts
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Stephen Cellucci]]
